description: The three ontological hypotheses analyzed in EFC Ontological Foundations

hypotheses.name: Energy-Flow Primacy
hypotheses.description: Energy-flow is the fundamental concept; entropy emerges from it
hypotheses.failure_reason: energy_flow requires direction, direction requires entropy, entropy requires energy

hypotheses.name: Entropy Primacy
hypotheses.description: Entropy is the fundamental concept; energy-flow emerges from it
hypotheses.failure_reason: entropy requires microstates, microstates requires energy, energy requires change, change requires entropy

hypotheses.name: Co-Primary Structure
hypotheses.description: EF and S emerge together from pre-geometric potential

conclusion: Only H3 (Co-Primary Structure) passes the circularity test
